authority: repository-wide evidence-hash audit, 2026-08-16 (26 distinct (path, sha256) pairs recomputed; 25 clean, 1 mismatch, plus 56 unhashed broken pointers)
why_append_only: data/mlb/forecasts/grades.jsonl is an append-only hash-chained ledger (R6). The defective pointers CANNOT be rewritten in place without breaking the chain, so this record supersedes them and any verifier must resolve evidence for the named grade_ids through here.

correction_1_mispaired_hash.defect: all 13 bind path data/mlb/box/2026-07-26_and_07-28_extract.json to sha256 c18668285900c92a8fc3f167c8b76e589e825cbcb70c0dcee8d28a2755868744, which is NOT that file's hash.
correction_1_mispaired_hash.root_cause: path/hash MISPAIRING, not corruption or tampering: c18668... is the sha256 of the UPSTREAM artifact data/mlb/box/2026-07-26_and_07-28_savant_paste.txt (confirmed by a full-repo 937-file hash sweep — exactly one file matches). Both files are present and unmodified; git status clean.
correction_1_mispaired_hash.resolution: both artifacts are genuine and the evidence chain is intact once the pair is read correctly; no data is in doubt.

correction_2_broken_paths.affected: 56 grade records citing evidence/websearch/... under a truncated prefix
correction_2_broken_paths.defect: the cited prefix 'evidence/websearch/' does not resolve — there is no top-level evidence/ directory and git never tracked one.
correction_2_broken_paths.note: these 56 pointers carry NO expected hash, so they were invisible to hash-based verification. Hashes are computed and bound HERE for the first time.

correction_3_unhashable_by_nature.state: artifact_ref absent and original_file_hash explicitly null; pregame_evidence is the string 'conversation_transcript'
correction_3_unhashable_by_nature.disposition: NOT repairable from repository artifacts — the cited evidence lives outside the repo. The null is honest and self-declaring (the records do not claim a binding they lack), so it stays null. These 15 are already cohort RETROSPECTIVE_ARCHIVED / EXCLUDED_FROM_ALL_AGGREGATES and must never be promoted.

correction_4_wnba_official_ledger_wordin.corrects: data/mlb/analysis/2026-08-15_validation_sweep.json phrase 'official ledger now 7/8 sides, mean Brier 0.1064 ... the provisional and official ledgers have merged'
correction_4_wnba_official_ledger_wordin.defect: that sentence folded THREE TIER-3-basis grades (G-WNBA-V1-20260813-*) into what it called the official ledger alongside five genuine tier-1 grades. Under the 2026-08-16 ruling those are different evidence tiers and must not be pooled.
correction_4_wnba_official_ledger_wordin.corrected_statement: WNBA tier-1 cohort: n=5, 4-1 sides, mean Brier 0.1305. WNBA tier-3 pre-ruling cohort: n=3, 3-0 sides, mean Brier 0.0663. These are reported separately by harness/cohort_backtest.py and are never summed.

The stated precondition was never met. The grades stand (append-only) as a documented pre-ruling exception.

correction_5_orphaned_provisional_record.defect: carries MIL@SD as '6-4' and KC@LAD as 'UNRESOLVED'. Tier-1/verified state: MIL@SD was won by SAN DIEGO (winner-only tier-1 row, home_win=0; tier-3 score 2-11 held in the 8/11 acquisition ledger) and KC@LAD has a tier-1 winner-only row. The 6-4 is both wrong and orientation-reversed relative to the truth.
correction_5_orphaned_provisional_record.why_this_record_exists: the sweep found this file FULLY ORPHANED — zero machine-readable references to its record_id anywhere, and the incident file that reverses it (2026-08-11_milsd_reversal_incident.json) carries no `corrects` field. A reader opening the original got superseded numbers with no in-band signal. That is now fixed by this record plus data/audit/supersession_index.json.

structural_fix_adopted: all correction records must name the target record_id in a `corrects`/`supersedes` field. data/audit/supersession_index.json is generated from those fields so any record can be checked for a successor in one lookup instead of a full-repo grep.
